intro_text.en: Start with a practical situation,draw the model,and solve one step at a time.
intro_text.gu: Practical પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂ કરીએ,model દોરીએ અને એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલીએ.

h.en: 2.1.1 A hanging ring is a complete problem
h.gu: 2.1.1 લટકતી Ring પોતે આખો Problem છે

body.en:
Start with a situation

Two cables hold a load at a ring. The cable pulls and weight act through one small region, so begin with a particle free-body diagram.

Definition

Coplanar concurrent forces have lines of action in one plane meeting at a point. Their resultant is the vector sum through that point.

Understand the reason

Choose axes, draw every external force on the isolated ring, then resolve. The picture determines the signs; memory alone does not.

Example / application

Tension pulls away from the ring along a cable; weight points vertically down.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Do not draw both a cable tension and its equal-opposite reaction on the same isolated ring.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

બે cables ring પર load પકડે.Cable pulls,weight એક નાના regionમાંથી લાગે,એટલે particle free-body diagramથી શરૂ કરીએ.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Coplanar concurrent forcesની lines એક planeમાં એક point પર મળે.Resultant તે pointમાંથી જતો vector sum છે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Axes લો,isolated ring પરના બધા external forces દોરો,પછી resolve કરો.Picture signs નક્કી કરે,ફક્ત memory નહિ.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Tension cableની દિશામાં ringથી દૂર ખેંચે;weight vertically નીચે લાગે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

એ જ isolated ring પર cable tension અને તેની equal-opposite reaction બન્ને ન દોરો.

body.en:
Definition

Resolution replaces a force by components whose vector sum is that force. For theta measured counterclockwise from+x:Fx=Fcos theta, Fy=Fsin theta.

Understand the reason

Components are signed projections on perpendicular axes. A negative Fx means force toward−x, not a negative force magnitude.

If the angle is given from the vertical, identify adjacent/opposite sides before choosing sine/cosine. A direction triangle can supply direction ratios.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A component is not a separate additional force to be counted together with the original force.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Resolutionમાં forceને એવા componentsથી બદલીએ કે તેમનો vector sum મૂળ force થાય.+xથી counterclockwise theta હોય તો Fx=Fcos theta,Fy=Fsin theta.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Components perpendicular axes પરના signed projections છે.Negative Fx એટલે−x તરફ,negative force magnitude નહિ.

Angle verticalથી આપ્યો હોય તો sine/cosine પહેલાં adjacent/opposite sides જુઓ.Direction triangleથી direction ratios મળે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Componentને મૂળ forceની સાથે વધારાનો અલગ force ગણીને ન ઉમેરો.

body.en:
Given

F500 N acts along a3–4–5 direction triangle:toward+x,+y with horizontal ratio3 and vertical ratio4.

Stepwise solution

  1. Fx=500(3/5)=300 N; Fy=500(4/5)=400 N
  2. sqrt(Fx²+Fy²)=sqrt(300²+400²)=500 N; theta=atan2(400,300)=53.130°

Remember / avoid this mistake

If the same line points up-left, Fx=−300 N, Fy=+400 N and direction126.870° from+x.

Quick check: If angle is from+y, can you blindly useFx=Fcos theta?

No. Relate the angle to the chosen axes first.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

F500N,3–4–5 direction triangle મુજબ+x,+y તરફ છે;horizontal ratio3,vertical4.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Fx=500(3/5)=300N;Fy=500(4/5)=400N
  2. sqrt(Fx²+Fy²)=sqrt(300²+400²)=500N;theta=atan2(400,300)=53.130°

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

એ જ line up-left હોય તો Fx=−300N,Fy=+400N અને+xથી direction126.870°.

જાતે વિચારો: Angle+yથી હોય તો સીધું Fx=Fcos theta?

ના.પહેલા angleને chosen axes સાથે જોડો.

body.en:
Definition

Rx=sumFx, Ry=sumFy; R=sqrt(Rx²+Ry²).Use atan2(Ry, Rx) or an explicitly corrected quadrant for direction.

The equilibrant is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to the resultant at the concurrent point. Equilibrium requires sumFx=0, sumFy=0 for this planar particle model.

Remember / avoid this mistake

For a general planar rigid body, sumM=0 is also necessary. Concurrent forces have zero moment about their common point; this does not excuse omitting moments for a beam.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Rx=sumFx,Ry=sumFy;R=sqrt(Rx²+Ry²).Direction માટે atan2(Ry,Rx) કે સ્પષ્ટ quadrant correction લો.

Equilibrant concurrent point પર resultant જેટલો અને વિરુદ્ધ directionમાં હોય.Operational planar particle modelમાં equilibrium માટે sumFx=0,sumFy=0 જોઈએ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

General planar rigid bodyમાં sumM=0 પણ જોઈએ.Concurrent forcesનો common point વિશે moment zero છે;એટલે beamમાં moments છોડવા નહિ.

body.en:
Given

At a point:F1=100 N along+x, F2=80 N at90°, F3=60 N at180°.

Stepwise solution

  1. Rx=100−60=40 N; Ry=80 N
  2. R=sqrt(40²+80²)=89.4427 N
  3. theta=atan2(80,40)=63.4349° from+x
  4. Equilibrant components=(−40,−80)N; direction243.4349°

Remember / avoid this mistake

Resultant is not100+80+60=240 N because forces have different directions.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Point પર F1=100N+x,F2=80N90°,F3=60N180°.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Rx=100−60=40N;Ry=80N
  2. R=sqrt(40²+80²)=89.4427N
  3. theta=atan2(80,40)=63.4349° from+x
  4. Equilibrant components=(−40,−80)N;direction243.4349°

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Directions જુદી હોવાથી resultant100+80+60=240N નથી.

h.en: 2.1.6 Parallelogram law:two forces at one point
h.gu: 2.1.6 Parallelogram Law:એક Point પર બે Forces

body.en:
Definition

If two concurrent forces are represented by adjacent sides of a parallelogram, the diagonal from their common tail represents their resultant.

Stepwise solution

  1. Draw forces P, Q tail-to-tail to scale with included angle alpha.
  2. Complete the parallel sides and draw the diagonal from the common tail.
  3. Analytically:R=sqrt(P²+Q²+2PQcos alpha); angle fromP follows atan2(Qsin alpha, P+Qcos alpha).

Example / application

ForP=300 N, Q=400 N, alpha90°, R500 N and angle fromP53.130°.

Remember / avoid this mistake

The parallelogram included angle and the interior angle of a head-to-tail force triangle are supplementary; do not mix formula signs.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

બે concurrent forces parallelogramની adjacent sidesથી દર્શાવીએ તો common tailમાંથી diagonal તેમનો resultant આપે.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. P,Qને included angle alpha સાથે tail-to-tail scaleમાં દોરો.
  2. Parallel sides પૂરી કરી common tailથી diagonal દોરો.
  3. Analytical રીતે:R=sqrt(P²+Q²+2PQcos alpha);Pથી angle atan2(Qsin alpha,P+Qcos alpha)થી મળે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

P300N,Q400N,alpha90° માટે R500N અને Pથી angle53.130°.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Parallelogramનો included angle અને head-to-tail triangleનો interior angle supplementary છે;formula signs ભેળવો નહિ.

body.en:
Definition

Triangle law:two forces represented in magnitude/direction by successive triangle sides have a resultant along the third side from the first tail to last head.

Polygon law extends the same head-to-tail addition to several forces. A closed polygon means zero resultant within construction accuracy.

Stepwise solution

  1. Select a force scale and angular reference; draw the first force.
  2. From each arrowhead draw the next force parallel to its actual line and with correct sense.
  3. Join first tail to last head for resultant; reverse it for equilibrant. Measure length/direction and apply the scale.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Graphical answers have drawing/measurement error; report a sensible precision and compare with analytical components, not fabricated agreement.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Triangle lawમાં successive sidesથી બે forces દર્શાવીએ તો first tailથી last head સુધીની third side resultant આપે.

Polygon law એ જ head-to-tail addition ઘણા forces માટે વાપરે.Closed polygon construction accuracyમાં zero resultant બતાવે.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Force scale,angular reference લઈ પહેલો force દોરો.
  2. દરેક arrowheadથી next force actual lineને parallel અને સાચા senseમાં દોરો.
  3. First tailથી last head જોડો=resultant;reverse=equilibrant.Length/direction માપી scale લો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Graphical answersમાં drawing/measurement error છે;યોગ્ય precision આપીને analytical components સાથે સરખાવો,બનાવટી agreement નહિ.

h.en: 2.1.8 Lami theorem:only the right three forces
h.gu: 2.1.8 Lami Theorem:યોગ્ય ત્રણ Forces માટે જ

body.en:
Definition

For a particle in equilibrium under exactly three coplanar concurrent non-collinear forces:F1/sin alpha=F2/sin beta=F3/sin gamma, where each denominator angle is between the other two forces.

Stepwise solution

  1. Draw the three actual force directions on an FBD.
  2. Label for each force the angle between the other two forces.
  3. Apply the sine ratios, solve magnitudes and verify with component equilibrium.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Do not use Lami for four forces or substitute the angle a force makes with+x as its opposite angle.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

બરાબર ત્રણ coplanar concurrent non-collinear forcesથી particle equilibriumમાં હોય તો F1/sin alpha=F2/sin beta=F3/sin gamma;દરેક denominatorનો angle બીજા બે forces વચ્ચેનો છે.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. FBDમાં ત્રણ actual directions દોરો.
  2. દરેક force માટે બીજા બે વચ્ચેનો angle label કરો.
  3. Sine ratiosથી magnitudes કાઢી component equilibriumથી તપાસો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

ચાર forces માટે Lami ન લો અને forceનો+x સાથેનો angle denominatorમાં ન મૂકો.

body.en:
Given

A1000 N load hangs from a ring. Left cable30° above horizontal; right cable60° above horizontal.

Stepwise solution

  1. sumFx=0:−TLcos30°+TRcos60°=0; TR=sqrt(3)TL
  2. sumFy=0:TLsin30°+TRsin60°=1000
  3. TL=500 N; TR=866.0254 N
  4. Lami check:TL/sin150°=TR/sin120°=1000/sin90°=1000 N

Remember / avoid this mistake

The upward cable angles are not themselves the Lami opposite angles. Check that vertical components add to the weight.

Quick check: Why is the steeper cable tension larger here?

Horizontal balance gives TR=sqrt(3)TL; vertical balance then sets the magnitudes.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Ring પર1000N load છે.Left cable horizontalથી30° ઉપર,right cable60° ઉપર.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. sumFx=0:−TLcos30°+TRcos60°=0;TR=sqrt(3)TL
  2. sumFy=0:TLsin30°+TRsin60°=1000
  3. TL=500N;TR=866.0254N
  4. Lami check:TL/sin150°=TR/sin120°=1000/sin90°=1000N

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Cableના upward angles સીધા Lami opposite angles નથી.Vertical components weight જેટલા થાય તે જુઓ.

જાતે વિચારો: અહીં Steeper Cableનું Tension વધુ કેમ?

Horizontal balanceથી TR=sqrt(3)TL;પછી vertical balance magnitudes આપે.

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. Isolate one body→show all external forces→state axes/angle convention→resolve→write equilibrium or resultant equations→solve with units→check direction and balance.
  2. For graphical work write the scale, retain construction lines, label vectors and state the approximate measured result. For theorem questions add statement, diagram, conditions and application.

Remember / avoid this mistake

The force table/pulley experiments need supervised setup and real observed readings; the worked examples here are illustrative calculations, not completed laboratory work.

Quick check: CanR=0 be claimed if only sumFx=0?

No.sumFy must also vanish in this model.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. એક body isolate→બધા external forces→axes/angle convention→resolve→equilibrium/resultant equations→units સાથે solve→direction,balance check.
  2. Graphicalમાં scale લખો,construction lines રાખો,vectors label કરો,approximate result આપો.Theoremમાં statement,diagram,conditions,application ઉમેરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Force table/pulley experiments supervised setup અને real readings માંગે;અહીં worked examples illustrative calculations છે,completed lab work નહિ.

જાતે વિચારો: ફક્ત sumFx=0થી R=0?

ના.આ modelમાં sumFy પણ zero જોઈએ.
